data.name: Aditya
data.gender_notes: Aditya is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Patronymic from Aditi, the mother of the gods — 'son of Aditi', i.e. the sun. Its root is Sanskrit aditi (अदिति). A Vedic name of the sun god. Aditya is a Sanskrit name meaning “The sun; son of Aditi”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aditya expresses “The sun; son of Aditi”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: Patronymic from Aditi, the mother of the gods — 'son of Aditi', i.e. the sun.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aditya total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

faq.q: What is the lucky number for Aditya?
faq.a: The Pythagorean lucky number for Aditya is 6 (ruling planet Venus). This is an interpretive association, not a factual claim.

faq.a: Friday is the traditional association for Aditya. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which gemstone is associated with Aditya?
faq.a: Diamond is the traditional association for Aditya. This is interpretive.

faq.q: Which colours are associated with Aditya?
faq.a: White, Pink are the traditional associations for Aditya. These are interpretive.

faq.q: What is the numerology of Aditya?
faq.a: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aditya total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

faq.a: The meaning of Aditya carries confidence HIGH in this record. It is established by classical lexicography or scripture.

faq.a: Aditya is recorded as a hindu name meaning “The sun; son of Aditi”.

faq.q: What is the English meaning of Aditya?
faq.a: In English, Aditya is rendered as “The sun; son of Aditi”.

faq.q: Is Aditya suitable for a baby?
faq.a: Aditya is used as a male given name; suitability is a personal choice.

faq.q: Which culture uses the name Aditya?
faq.a: Aditya is used in Sanskrit naming traditions.

faq.q: Does Aditya have a positive meaning?
faq.a: Aditya carries the meaning “The sun; son of Aditi”.
